task_instance: Create a minimal Quarkus 3.40.1 REST project and build a GraalVM/Mandrel native executable from it (the skill's headline deliverable), using the skill's recommended container-build command './mvnw package -Dnative -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true' so no local GraalVM is required.
blocker_detail: The native build cannot be produced. The skill's primary 'no local GraalVM needed' path performs the native-image compilation inside a Mandrel builder container that Quarkus pulls from a Red Hat-hosted container registry (image ubi9-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image, tag jdk-25). The agent HTTPS proxy refuses that registry host with 403 Forbidden, so the pull fails ('Failed to pull builder image ... Forbidden') and the native-image build step aborts. The alternative local path (./mvnw package -Dnative) is also unavailable because the runtime provides no GraalVM/Mandrel native-image compiler (native-image not on PATH, GRAALVM_HOME unset); the Mandrel tarball download referenced by the skill would come from an external host that the proxy would likewise block. The runtime's own Docker daemon works (a hello-world image pulled from the default public registry succeeded), and the Quarkus project itself is sound: during the native build the JVM compile and unit-test phase ran to completion (app started on JVM, tests passed) and the build failed only at the builder-image pull.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r144. Environment probe: java 21.0.12, Maven 3.9.11, Gradle present, Docker 29.9.2 (daemon up, pulled hello-world from default registry OK); no podman, no quarkus CLI, no native-image, GRAALVM_HOME empty. Project bootstrapped with 'mvn io.quarkus.platform:quarkus-maven-plugin:3.40.1:create -DprojectArtifactId=code-with-quarkus -Dextensions=rest' into code-with-quarkus/ (pom quarkus.platform.version=3.40.1, 'native' profile present with quarkus.native.enabled=true) using a work-local Maven repo (-Dmaven.repo.local=<work>/.m2repo). Ran 'mvn package -Dnative -Dquarkus.native.container-build=true': JVM build + tests succeeded (log: 'code-with-quarkus 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT on JVM ... started', 'Installed features: [cdi, rest, ...]'), then NativeImageBuildStep failed with 'java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to pull builder image' and daemon error 'failed to resolve reference ... manifests/jdk-25: Forbidden' (proxy 403). No target/*-runner native binary was produced, so the deliverable could not be verified. Per run rules I did not attempt to substitute a different/un-blocked builder image or install a native toolchain from an external host as a workaround.
